still present, also some findings:

- disabling fbt does not fix it

- changing avatar does not fix it

- even to default avatars like unity chan

- calibration mode does not fix it (cant calibrate tho because my view point also goes away from avatar)

- even rotating head can send you flying

- rotation left/right actually rotates you along some axis with unknown origin point, like 2 meters below you and rotating to the right like -> head going to right leg

- you can achieve a semi-stable position when you can even walk, tho usually only on one axis. the position can be random, like sideways.

@{5f2dea8d22470972dc58e995|full_name}: It's not an avatar issue, it's a collision issue with the player intersecting with world colliders at 0,0,0 on spawn and ejecting violently.

@{5e89d0822aedbc56a3155d12|full_name}: well respawning fixes it usually, so its kinda weird that changing avatar does not, and it goes forever, you can't escape whatever is happening. So its a bit weird how its happening

@{5f2dea8d22470972dc58e995|full_name}: Respawning fixds it because it's an issue occurring during the world loading and your initial spawn-in.  Something is occurring asynchronously so your avatar gains collision before being placed at the spawn point and Physics Occurs.

@{5f2dea8d22470972dc58e995|full_name}: I think because your world collision capsule is always the same size. It doesn't re-initialize on avatar change but it likely does when you respawn since it's technically updating the location of it.

@{5f2dea8d22470972dc58e995|full_name}: I commented previously that toggling OSC fixes the mangled FBT/IK. Since nothing else fixes it and OSC can control FBT, I wonder if it is really some very obscure OSC bug — that should be verifiable by checking OSC debug data when it happens.

details:
Spawning as the first joiner may occasionally violently jerk/yeet/throw you around in the world at high velocity until respawn.

Reproduction steps:

- Unknown reproduction steps

- The effect reportedly happens rarely

- The effect can happen in the home world right after VRChat starts

Observed:

- The player is violently thrown around in the world at high velocity

- The camera can roll in such a way that the virtual world's horizon will no longer match the real playspace horizon, causing loss of balance

- The player may sometimes bypass the world colliders, going out the normal boundaries of the world

- The effect persists until respawn is triggered by going out Y bounds

- Before the effect happens, the player sometimes spawns outside of the world, or in a location that is not normally a spawn

- This appears to only affect the first joiner of a world (instance master)

- If the user was already in calibrated inside full body tracking, the avatar may be mangled with incorrect IK target positions until the avatar is reset
title: [1319] Spawning as the first joiner may occasionally violently jerk/yeet/throw you around in the world at high velocity until respawn
